design: BOSS: a huge mature spider queen with credible ARTHROPOD anatomy: exactly EIGHT long segmented legs in FOUR pairs, a low armored thorax, one large dark obsidian/plum abdomen with a restrained crimson crown/hourglass marking, a cluster of small hostile red/amber eyes and TWO curved ivory fangs. No humanoid face or eyebrows, no toy-like round eyes, no cute exaggerated features. Serious hand-painted dark fantasy carapace materials matching the player's painted armor/shading, without photorealistic horror or gore. Body three-quarter facing RIGHT; far legs may be partly occluded naturally. Idle legs planted and abdomen breathing, hurt recoils/contracts legs, attack raises front pair then lunges with fangs toward RIGHT, recovery; dodge flattens and scuttles backward briefly then returns. Same eight-leg/one-abdomen anatomy and markings all16poses. No loose web/smoke/effects; generous clear margins, full leg tips in every cell.
prompt: Repack this SAME sixteen-pose 4x4 sprite sheet. Uniformly make every entire creature 25% smaller inside its own equal cell to leave generous transparent margins ALL sides and between ALL neighbors. Reconstruct any clipped wing, tail or leg tip. Preserve the SAME serious mature anatomy, exact species design, correct limbs, colors and ALL corresponding poses. NO figure may touch another or the canvas edges. Four rows idle, hurt, attack, dodge; facing RIGHT; true transparency, no shadows/text.
